author: blu
body: A truncated sequence at the end of the buffer answers negative one rather than reading past it, so a file cut mid-character is a dropped character and not a fault.

author: blu
body: A code point CCE does not carry is dropped, which is the same answer the compiler's own boundary gives a carriage return. A byte that decodes to nothing advances by one so a malformed run cannot stall the walk.

author: blu
body: text-length is a byte count, so the walk steps by the CCE character's own width rather than by one.
